## What

<!-- Structure:
       1. First line: a short summary of specifically what is being done,
          as a complete sentence written as though it were an order
          ("Delete the FizzBuzz RPC and replace it...").
       2. A blank line.
       3. Details: any supplemental information a reader needs to understand
          the PR holistically — a brief description of the problem being
          solved, why this is the best approach, shortcomings, bug numbers,
          benchmark results, and links to design documents.
       4. A Mermaid diagram giving an overview of the change. -->

## Why

<!-- Why are these changes being made? What context did you have as the
     author? Were there decisions you made that aren't reflected in the
     source code? -->

## Quality Assurance

<!-- Evidence the change works: commands run, test results, screenshots,
     manual verification steps. Do not repeat checks that CI already
     guarantees (e.g. build, lint, automated tests). -->

## References

<!-- Links to related issues, design docs, and prior discussions. Note that
     external links may not be visible to future readers — include enough
     context in the description itself. -->
